name: SinD
summary: 信号交叉口无人机轨迹数据，包含异构交通参与者的连续位置、运动学、地图和信号灯信息。
summaryEn: Drone-observed signalized-intersection trajectories with heterogeneous road users, kinematics, maps, and traffic-light context.
scale: Original Tianjin subset: 7 hours and over 13,000 participants
scaleZh: 原始天津子集约 7 小时，超过 13,000 名交通参与者
license: Custom non-commercial terms; LICENSE modifies CC0 language
licenseZh: 自定义非商业条款；LICENSE 修改了 CC0 文本
access: Public samples; full data requested with educational email
accessZh: 公开示例；完整数据需用教育邮箱申请
verdict: 交通信号条件多智能体轨迹
wmNote: 轨迹、运动学和信号可用于未来交互预测；原始版与后续多城市版需按发布范围区分。
wmNoteEn: Trajectories, kinematics, and signals support interaction forecasting; distinguish original and later multicity release scopes.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2209.02297] SIND: A Drone Dataset at Signalized Intersection in China
evidence.statement: Drone-recorded signalized-intersection road-user trajectories explicitly support behavior modeling and motion prediction.
